RandomX — vendored third-party source (verbatim, unmodified)
============================================================

Upstream:      https://github.com/tevador/RandomX
License:       BSD-3-Clause (see ./LICENSE, copied verbatim)
Copyright:     (c) 2018-2019 tevador <tevador@gmail.com>; (c) 2014-2019 The Monero Project

CONSENSUS PIN (what we vendor):
  tevador/RandomX @ 12f2c2ffe2108d6cf54c391fee33c8bc3646cdab
  This is the EXACT commit monero-project/monero references at
  external/randomx on master (read 2026-09-05). It is the RandomX the
  running Monero mainnet ("rx/0") consensus uses. It PREDATES RandomX 2.0:
  it defines NO RANDOMX_FLAG_V2 (verified — enum tops out at RANDOMX_FLAG_ARGON2
  = 96). Vendoring this exact commit gives c2pool bug-for-bug hash identity
  with monerod.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
WHAT IS VENDORED (updated in wave X8 — the full source now lands)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Until X8 only the two compile-time API headers were vendored (the library was
to be consumed as a package-time submodule archive). X8 vendors the ENTIRE
upstream src/ tree so the RandomX static library builds on CI hosts WITHOUT a
submodule init or network fetch, and so an auditor can byte-diff the consensus
code against upstream in one command.

1) ./src/  — the COMPLETE upstream src/ tree, copied BYTE-IDENTICAL from
   tevador/RandomX @ 12f2c2ff (no edits; every upstream BSD-3 file header
   preserved verbatim). 106 files, including src/asm/, src/blake2/, src/tests/.
   29 C/C++/asm translation units. This is the code librandomx.a is built from.

   Re-verify (must print nothing / exit 0):
       git clone https://github.com/tevador/RandomX rx && \
       git -C rx checkout 12f2c2ffe2108d6cf54c391fee33c8bc3646cdab && \
       diff -r rx/src ./src

   Reproducible aggregate of the vendored src/ tree
   (path-sorted per-file sha256, hashed):
       6f4315da5572fbc2bc8aa33adcf2329a91948aec5d3eec63fba65e77f1668e7b
   Reproduce with:
       ( cd ./src && find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum \
         | sha256sum )

2) ./randomx.h, ./configuration.h  — the two compile-time API headers, kept at
   this directory ROOT (unchanged since the foundation). They are BYTE-IDENTICAL
   to ./src/randomx.h and ./src/configuration.h; they remain here because the
   c2pool wrapper (pow/randomx_verify.hpp) and the foundation include path
   reference them directly. Duplication is intentional and harmless — both are
   the same bytes as upstream.

       randomx.h        <- src/randomx.h        sha256 ba6784194be25810f0c25d4b767907e9aa133cb3cf8ba605ce94ab593856f4c3
       configuration.h  <- src/configuration.h  sha256 637719f77c263cab40ca306ca0326ef37d6f6eb12564c7feb5c74c0426c74051

3) ./LICENSE  — upstream LICENSE, copied verbatim.
       LICENSE          <- LICENSE              sha256 7d85758a95990168395d0940b2a103b6be0c2eba3995f00cbb59d23a86c2214e

NOT UPSTREAM (c2pool-authored, AGPL-3.0-or-later — NOT part of the byte-diff):
  ./CMakeLists.txt  — c2pool's OWN build wiring. Builds a single static archive
      `randomx` from ./src in LIGHT mode (256 MiB Argon2d cache only; NO
      FULL_MEM / NO 2 GiB dataset; RANDOMX_FLAG_JIT optional with a portable
      interpreter fallback). It contains none of upstream's CMake text — only
      the source LIST (the TUs RandomX needs) is common, which is data, not
      code. c2pool AGPL applies to this file; the vendored ./src stays BSD-3.
      (Exclude ./CMakeLists.txt when byte-diffing ./ against upstream — it has
      no upstream counterpart at this path.)

LICENSE COMPATIBILITY:
  RandomX is BSD-3-Clause; c2pool is AGPL-3.0-or-later. BSD-3 is permissively
  portable into an AGPL work: the vendored BSD-3 files keep their headers and
  LICENSE verbatim (above), and the combined binary is distributed under AGPL.

FUTURE-FORK REFERENCE (not vendored now):
  tevador/RandomX @ 7c761cf007c758056dcb6eb438a32f780f81bdbd (post-2.0 HEAD)
  adds RANDOMX_FLAG_V2 and the v2 program constants. It is the upgrade target
  IF/WHEN a Monero hard-fork adopts RandomX 2.0 (PowAlgo RX_2). The wrapper
  #ifdef-guards every RANDOMX_FLAG_V2 use, so it already compiles unchanged
  against either pin.

Nothing under ./src (or the root header/LICENSE copies) is adapted or modified;
therefore no per-file provenance comment is injected into the copied sources
(that would break the byte-diff auditors use to confirm the vendored consensus
code is untouched). Provenance for these verbatim copies lives in this sidecar.
